newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia '97 Q1 non-CIS oil exports seen 25.7 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Russia '97 Q1 non-CIS oil exports seen 25.7 mln T.

text.p: Russia is likely to raise crude oil exports to non-Commonwealth of Independent States destinations to 25.7 million tonnes in the first quarter of 1997, Interfax news agency quoted the Fuel ministry as saying.
It quoted documents drawn up by Russia's Fuel and Energy ministry as saying exports in the same period of last year were 23.8 million tonnes.
The quarterly figures include transit of about one million tonnes of Kazakhstan oil through Russia.
The documents said the figures may be corrected as soon as the ministry draws up concrete exports schedules.
Each Russian vertically-integrated oil firm would export about 17 percent of output for its own needs and 12 percent of output under a federal exports programme, the documents said.
